context: Daniel meets Sara at a park.
It is late, so call it a day. Take it one step at a time.
dialogue: Daniel: Sara, do you have harmony in your life?
Sara: Yes. She looks for harmony in her life.
Daniel: Good. Pause and take a breath.
Sara: Yes. A good plan can save time.
Daniel: True. Take it one step at a time.
Sara: Good. It is late, so call it a day.

lessons.speakingSample: I want to tell you about time in a new situation. On Monday, Daniel met Sara at a park. Sara said, 'She looks for harmony in her life. Pause and take a breath.' A good plan can save time. Take it one step at a time. It is late, so call it a day. I will save time and look for harmony.
lessons.writing: Write a short email to a friend. Tell them about time in a new situation. Say what you did and how it ended.
lessons.writingSample: Dear Anna, I want to tell you about time in a new situation. On Monday, Daniel met Sara at a park. Sara said, 'She looks for harmony in her life. Pause and take a breath.' A good plan can save time. Take it one step at a time. It is late, so call it a day. I will save time and look for harmony too, and I will pause and take a breath. Please tell me about your work. Best, Sara
lessons.sound: Harmony has its strongest beat on HAR. In harmony, say HAR clearly at the start. In pause, say PAUSE clearly.
